articles.text: MĚIGUO XUÉSHENG: Nǐ zěnme yíge rén zài zhèli? Nǐde nǚpéngyou ne?
AMERICAN STUDENT: How come you're all alone here? Where's your girlfriend?
ZHŌNGGUO XUÉSHENG: Zài túshūguǎn niàn tāde jīngjìxué.
CHINESE STUDENT: She's in the library studying her economics.
MĚIGUO XUÉSHENG: Tā zhēn yònggōng! Zhème hǎode tiānqì, hái zài pīnmìng niàn shū!
AMERICAN STUDENT: She really works hard! The weather is so nice, and she's still knocking herself out studying.
ZHŌNGGUO XUÉSHENG: Shì a! Gāngcái, wǒ qù gěi tā sòngle yìdiǎn Kěkǒukělè, wǒ gēn tā shuō, zhèiyàng niànxiaqu shi yào shēng bìngde, kěshi tā bù tīng, háishi zài nàr niàn.
CHINESE STUDENT: That's right! Just now, I went to take her a Coke, and I told her she was going to get sick if she kept on studying like this, but she wouldn't listen. She just went on studying.
MĚIGUO XUÉSHENG: Wǒ xiǎng nǐde nǚpéngyou yǒu diǎnr tèbié, wǒmen bānlide jǐge nǚshēng zǎo jiù pǎo dào hǎibiānr qù wánr le.
AMERICAN STUDENT: I think your girlfriend is a little unusual. Several of the women students in our class took off for the beach a long time ago.
ZHŌNGGUO XUÉSHENG: Zhè hé tāde jiātíng yǒu guānxi.
CHINESE STUDENT: It has to do with her family.
MĚIGUO XUÉSHENG: Zěnme ne?
AMERICAN STUDENT: What do you mean?
ZHŌNGGUO XUÉSHENG: Tāde fùmǔ yǒu zhòng nán qīng nǚde lǎo guānniàn. Tāmen xiǎng érzi shi zìjǐde, nǚér zhǎngdàle zǒng yào jiéhūnde, jiéle hūn jiù shi biérén jiāde rén le, niàn shū yǒu shénme yòng?

CHINESE STUDENT: Her parents have the old idea of regarding men as superior to women. They think that a son is theirs, but a daughter gets married sooner or later when she grows up, and after she's married she belongs to another family — so what use is it for her to get an education?
MĚIGUO XUÉSHENG: Wǒ cónglái méiyou xiǎngdào, xiànzài hái yǒu zhèiyàngde jiātíng, zhèiyàngde fùmǔ.
AMERICAN STUDENT: I never imagined that there were still families and parents like that these days.
ZHŌNGGUO XUÉSHENG: Zhè méiyou shénme qíguài, bǎ lǎo guānniàn biànchéng xīn guānniàn bú shi yíjiàn róngyide shì.
CHINESE STUDENT: There's nothing so strange about that; it's not an easy thing to change one's old ideas into new ideas.
MĚIGUO XUÉSHENG: Nà, nǐde nǚpéngyou yǒu xiōngdì jiěmèi ma?
AMERICAN STUDENT: Then, does your girlfriend have any brothers and sisters?
ZHŌNGGUO XUÉSHENG: Yǒu, jiù yǒu yíge gēge.
CHINESE STUDENT: Yes, just one older brother.
MĚIGUO XUÉSHENG: Tā niàn shū niànde hǎo bu hǎo?
AMERICAN STUDENT: How does he do in school?
ZHŌNGGUO XUÉSHENG: Mǎmahūhū, wǒ xiǎng tā bú shi yíge hěn yònggōngde xuésheng.
CHINESE STUDENT: Just so-so; I don't think he's a very hard worker.
MĚIGUO XUÉSHENG: Nǐ rènshi ta?
AMERICAN STUDENT: You know him?

ZHŌNGGUO XUÉSHENG: Rènshi. Wǒ hé tāmen shi zhōngxué tóngxué. Tā gēge zhīdao tā niànwánle zhōngxué jiù kěyi shàng dàxué, kěshi tā fùmǔ bú ràng mèimei niàn dàxué. Wǒ kàndào tā chángcháng yíge rén zài túshūguǎn diào yǎnlèi, jiù wèn ta wèishénme. Mànmande, wǒ jiù zhīdao tāde qíngxing le.

CHINESE STUDENT: Yes. We were classmates in high school. Her brother knew that after he finished high school he could go to college, but her parents wouldn't let her go. I used to see her alone in the library, crying, and I asked her why. Gradually, I found out about her situation.
MĚIGUO XUÉSHENG: Ou, shi zhèiyàng! Nà tā shi zěnme lái dàxué niàn shūde ne?
AMERICAN STUDENT: Oh, so that's the story! So then, how was it that she came to college?

ZHŌNGGUO XUÉSHENG: Wǒ fùmǔ bāngzhu ta. Qùnián, tā zìjǐ yě zhuànle diǎn qián. Wǒ mǔqin shuō zhèige háizi zhème xiǎng niàn shū, wǒmen duō bāngzhu tā yìdiǎnr, ràng tā hǎohāo niàn shū ba! Zhèiyàng tā jiù bú zuò shì, zhǐ niàn shū le.

CHINESE STUDENT: My parents helped her out. Also, last year she earned some money on her own. My mother said she wanted so badly to study, that we should help her out and let her do it properly! This way she can just study without having to work.
MĚIGUO XUÉSHENG: Shi zhèiyàng! Wǒmen qù kànkan ta, ràng tā xiūxixiūxi.
AMERICAN STUDENT: Oh, is that so! Let's go see her, and make her take a break.
ZHŌNGGUO XUÉSHENG: Hǎo, zǒu!
CHINESE STUDENT: Good, let's go!
